svg.title: Mouse colon cross-section
svg.desc: Cross-section of the mouse distal colon: muscle coat, submucosa, crypt mucosa with goblet cells, a dense inner mucus layer free of microbes (accent), a loose outer mucus layer and lumen with microbes.
